summary: The study investigates the effects of nitrogen concentration on the electrical properties of ALD ZnO:N thin films and their application in TFTs. Nitrogen incorporation is controlled by varying NH4OH concentrations, leading to changes in carrier concentration, threshold voltage, and device performance. The ALD process allows for precise control of film composition and thickness, enabling the fabrication of flexible TFTs on PEN substrates.
